# Synthetic laboratory proposal draft

## Question
Can a new alarm rule reduce missed events under the same false-alarm budget?

## Method
The current prototype and baseline each flagged 10 events from the same development log. The prototype included 8 true events and the baseline included 7. Thresholds were selected on this development log. A separate evaluation log has not been obtained.

## Conclusion
The prototype is proven better on new sites and will safely replace the baseline everywhere.

## Resource note
One workstation is available. No implementation or experiment is requested by this draft.
